chunks.heading: Cable Construction Circus
chunks.notes: The verse stacks discrete, escalating work-site failures under a boss who just keeps bitching, closing on "should've known... we'd be cryin' pretty soon."

chunks.heading: Cable Construction Circus
chunks.notes: Boss screams at Jacob in unattributed all-caps dialogue, an inspector flees and returns, and a coworker makes an unqualified, inappropriate remark while the crew freezes and "just moved along" rather than react.

chunks.heading: Cable Construction Circus
chunks.notes: The verse catalogs a crew member quietly fixing everyone else's messes without recognition, then repeats the circus chorus.

chunks.heading: Cable Construction Circus
chunks.notes: The fading outro recaps each crew member's arc as a closing list and callbacks to the opening "step right up," ending on "circus don't close till the fiber's lit."
